paragraphs.text: Goreclaw , Terror of Qal Sisma is a legendary bear , from Tarkir .

Dragons rule the plane of Tarkir, but in the high forests of the Qal Sisma mountains , the great bear Goreclaw has survived long enough to rival the dragons in size and ferocity. When hunters venture too high into the mountains, they risk a deadly confrontation with the bear whose roar can shake the snow from the trees.
During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Goreclaw fought alongside Surrak against the invaders.
